solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Combination of parties in Arab location

indicators.note: in says the answer sits inside the run of letters of the words that follow

explanation.surface: A political alliance forming somewhere in the Arab world.
explanation.definitionFit: A bloc is a grouping of nations or political parties acting together in alliance.

clue.text: Everyone raised a small number — that's plain

indicators.note: in a down clue, raised means the word is read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: everyone means all
NO is the usual abbreviation for number

explanation.surface: Everybody lifted a modest figure, and that's simple.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' turns ALL into LLA in this down clue. 'plain' looks like an adjective meaning simple but is a noun.
explanation.definitionFit: A llano is a broad grassy plain of South America, especially in Venezuela.

clue.text: Big firm McLean organised, building playground amenity

indicators.note: organised means the letters are arranged into a new order

explanation.surface: A big company run by someone named McLean puts up equipment for a children's play area.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organised' rearranges the letters of BIG FIRM MCLEAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A structure of bars for children to scale is a standard piece of play-area equipment.

clue.text: Gift a private secretary carried — in this?

definitions.text: Gift a private secretary carried — in this?

indicators.note: carried means the following pieces are held inside the word for a gift

parts.note: a gift or talent is a knack
PS is the abbreviation for private secretary

explanation.surface: A present the secretary took along, perhaps in a bag on the back.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue doubles as the definition: a gift held by A PS might be carried in this bag.
explanation.definitionFit: A rucksack-style bag is something one carries items in on the back.

clue.text: Money set aside for child's cat?

definitions.meaning: a shared fund of money pooled for a purpose
a pet name a youngster uses for a cat

explanation.surface: A savings pot set aside for a youngster's pet.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a pooled fund of money and a childish word for a pussycat.

clue.text: Transport organisation in row after broadcast?

indicators.note: after puts the word for row following the word for broadcast

parts.note: to broadcast is to air
a row is a line

explanation.surface: A transport company caught up in a dispute after something went out on the radio.
explanation.walkthrough: 'row' suggests a quarrel, but here it is a line of things.
explanation.definitionFit: A company operating flights is an organisation that moves passengers.

clue.text: Authorisation to hunt war chest distributed around Scottish island?

indicators.note: around means the rearranged letters surround the island's name
distributed means the letters are spread about into a new order

parts.note: Arran is an island in the Firth of Clyde

explanation.surface: Permission to go looking for a hoard of military funds scattered round a Scottish isle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'distributed' turns WAR CHEST into SEARCHWT, and 'around' puts that round ARRAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A legal document lets police look through premises, so it permits them to hunt there.

clue.text: Stars accepting English name of Sulawesi once

indicators.note: accepting means the word for stars takes the abbreviation inside it

parts.note: famous stars are celebs

explanation.surface: Celebrities taking on an English label for an Indonesian island.
explanation.walkthrough: Sulawesi is a large Indonesian island formerly known by its colonial-era name.
explanation.definitionFit: Before independence the Indonesian island was called this, its old colonial-era title.

clue.text: Proceed on horseback, holding one's container

indicators.note: holding means the riding word surrounds the next piece

parts.note: to canter is to ride at an easy gallop
one's is I'S, one being I and the apostrophe-s being IS

explanation.surface: A rider sets off carrying a personal receptacle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one's' gives I + S, the Roman numeral one followed by S.
explanation.definitionFit: A canister is a cylindrical metal box used for storing things.

clue.text: Friend missing start of mass meeting

indicators.note: missing start of says the opening letter of the word for mass meeting is dropped

parts.note: a rally is a large gathering of people

explanation.surface: A companion who didn't turn up to the opening of a big gathering.
explanation.walkthrough: 'missing start of' removes R from RALLY.
explanation.definitionFit: An ally is a supporter or partner, so a friend in a cause.

clue.text: Hoyden's witty remark about lout from east

definitions.note: the apostrophe-s stands for is, so the definition is just the word hoyden

indicators.note: about means the word for witty remark is turned round

parts.note: a mot is a witty saying, as in bon mot

indicators.note: from east means the word for lout is read right to left in this across clue

parts.note: YOB is British slang for a lout

explanation.surface: A boisterous girl's joke concerns a thug from the eastern side.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns MOT into TOM and 'from east' turns YOB into BOY.
explanation.definitionFit: A hoyden is a boisterous, unladylike girl, an old-fashioned synonym.

clue.text: Rocky peak identified by mounting rubbish?

indicators.note: mounting in a down clue means the word is read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: rot means nonsense or rubbish

explanation.surface: A craggy summit recognised because someone is climbing a heap of trash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mounting' turns ROT into TOR in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A tor is a rocky hilltop, as on Dartmoor in England.

clue.text: Popular youngster beginning to interpret nightmares

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
a cub is a young animal or a junior scout

indicators.note: beginning to means take the first letter of the next word

explanation.surface: A well-liked child starts making sense of bad dreams.
explanation.definitionFit: Incubi are evil spirits once thought to cause bad dreams, and by extension bad dreams themselves.

clue.text: Crazy, serving drinks before 1960s dance!

indicators.note: before places the drinks word ahead of the dance

parts.note: buying a round means getting drinks for everyone
The Twist was a dance craze of the early 1960s

explanation.surface: A wild time: pouring drinks before doing an old 1960s dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Round the twist' is British slang for mad.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is British informal slang for mad or insane.

clue.text: Survive longer than old-fashioned cobbler's model

parts.note: something out is no longer in fashion
a last is the foot-shaped block a shoemaker works on

explanation.surface: A dated shoemaker's form keeps going for ages.
explanation.definitionFit: To outlast is to endure beyond someone or something else, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Revised rate for admission to the National, perhaps?

indicators.note: for admission to means the rearranged letters go inside the next word
revised means the letters are altered into another order

explanation.surface: New ticket prices for getting into the National, maybe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Revised' rearranges 'rate', and 'for admission to' puts the result inside 'the'. The National Theatre is on London's South Bank.
explanation.definitionFit: London's National Theatre is an example of a playhouse, hence the 'perhaps'.

clue.text: Draw an item of formal wear

definitions.meaning: a game ending level, with no winner
a neckpiece worn with a suit

explanation.surface: Sketch a piece of evening dress.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a level result in a game and a neckband worn with a shirt.

clue.text: Suppress part of list, if legitimate

indicators.note: part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Hold back a section of a list, provided it's above board.
explanation.definitionFit: To stifle a yawn or protest is to hold it in, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Neat coniferous tree

explanation.surface: A tidy evergreen.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both trim and smart in appearance and a kind of evergreen conifer.

clue.text: Diminutive head of shopping precinct

indicators.note: head of means take the first letter of the next word

parts.note: a shopping precinct is a mall

explanation.surface: A tiny manager in charge of a retail centre.
explanation.definitionFit: Diminutive means tiny, a straightforward synonym for little.

clue.text: Skill displayed by service in court

indicators.note: in places the service inside the abbreviation for court

parts.note: the RAF, the Royal Air Force, is one of the armed services

explanation.surface: Talent shown by a serve during a tennis match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'service' and 'court' suggest tennis, but service is the armed forces.
explanation.definitionFit: Craft means expertise or dexterity in making things, a synonym.

clue.text: Graduate crossing a lake, one in North Wales

indicators.note: crossing means the degree surrounds the following pieces

parts.note: BA, Bachelor of Arts, is a graduate
L is the map abbreviation for lake

explanation.surface: A graduate rowing across a lake in North Wales.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one' refers back to 'lake': Bala, or Llyn Tegid, is the largest natural lake in Wales.
explanation.definitionFit: Bala Lake in Gwynedd is the largest natural body of fresh water in Wales.

clue.text: Rush off, seeing reckless hooligan

definitions.meaning: to dash away in a hurry

explanation.surface: Run away on seeing a wild yob.
explanation.definitionFit: As two words it means to dash away; as one it is a reckless young person.

clue.text: Heavenly girl embracing soldiers first of all

indicators.note: embracing means the girl's name surrounds the following pieces

parts.note: Ethel is a girl's name
RE is the Royal Engineers, a body of soldiers

indicators.note: first of means take the opening letter of the next word

explanation.surface: A divine young woman holding troops above everyone else.
explanation.definitionFit: Ethereal means delicate and otherworldly, as if from the heavens.

clue.text: Carry a dram of liquor east

parts.note: a tot is a small measure of spirits

explanation.surface: Take a nip of spirits eastwards.
explanation.definitionFit: To tote is to haul or lug something, an informal synonym.
